title: Elpis
tagline: Decentralised microblogging app where you own your content and can earn from it without third party involved
description:
This app allows users to use all the normal social media functionality but more in a decentralised way. It will be a micro blogging app where you can share your thoughts and get incentives monetary for using the app.                   
     **Core Features and Functionality:**

1. Add Your Thoughts
    - The user can add their thoughts in the form of text, pic, or videos.
2. Create Your profile
   - User can customise their profile and get an NFT with unique levels depends 
      on followers, followings and posts.
3. Find and Follow Your friends
   - User can search other profile , follow them and connect with them
how_its_made:
This project uses MetaMask wallet as a Signer. 
The frontend is developed using Next.js and styled by Tailwind.css. 
For file storage(posts and media) IPFS is used as a decentralised storage system and each NFT is stored in nft.storage. 
The backend is developed in Solidity and Hardhat is used for local development and deployed on polygon mumbai testnet. 
IPFS is the crucial part of the Dapp because any social media requires a large amount of data storage and IPFS was the best option available. All the metadata related to profile, posts are stored in IPFS.
